title: Prove #4100 COMPLEX.md's stopped complex recursion meets O(V h^(1-q) polylog p) for every h under its node premises (no new κ)
body:
## Result

This adds `research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost/`, a scoped proof for one #4100 native/complex-family implication: COMPLEX.md's "Time" bill. The stopped complex recursion costs `O(V h^(1-q) polylog p)` for **every** root width `h >= 1`. No new κ. #4100 is not accepted, and the selected frontier is unchanged.

**Claim type:** a written all-size proof under COMPLEX.md's own premises, plus certified finite enclosures and numerical tree corroboration.

The premises stay explicit:

- **(N)** node cost `O(V e^(1-a2) polylog p)`, the `e mod 73` remainder bits, and child volume `(H_r/W) v` at width `r floor(e/73)`;
- **(L)** leaves;
- **(P)** root placement;
- **(A)** additivity.

Under them, `PROOF.md` proves by strong induction on `e`:

```
cost(e, v) <= v [ K1 e^tau + c_L s^b e^(1-b) ],   K1 = (c_N Lambda + c_L)/(1 - mu_tau),
layer      <= V Lambda h^(1-q) [ (c_N + c_L)/(1 - mu_tau) + 73^b c_L + 2 c_P ].
```

The induction handles floors, remainders and any stop width `s >= 73` directly, with no monotonicity in `e`.

Certified facts (exact or outward-rounded rationals):

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `1 - mu_(1-b)` | `1.804257e-48` |
| `1 - mu_tau` | `1.417734591407e-28` |
| `1/(1 - mu_tau)` | in `(7.0535e27, 7.0536e27)` |
| exponent order | `1-a2 < tau < 1-q`, `1-b+eta*b < 1-q`, `72 <= 74^tau` |

**Callers.**

- PROOF.md's synthetic-transform layers (`1 <= h <= d-1`, at most `ell` levels) get `O(V ell d^(1-q) polylog p)`, including levels with fewer active axes.
- GAUSSIAN.md's compiled layers (`h = O(p^beta)`, `O(p^epsilon)`) get `O(V h^(1-q) polylog p)`.

**Observations.** None of these changes a downstream bound.

- The leaf term needs only `mu_(1-b) <= 1`.
- The `h^eta` stop is not used by this bill.
- The floor is necessary. With a ceiling, a width-74 node has a width-96 child.
- The uniform constant exceeds `7e27 (c_N Lambda + c_L)`. Finite unit-cost trees show an internal `tau`-sum over `h^tau` of only 8.8 at `h = 10^12`, so the constant is a worst-case artifact, not a defect.

## Task and overlap

- **Card:** `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined to one non-CRT obligation (native/complex family).
- **Claim:** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19137702
- **Base:** canonical main `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`, priority revision 7. #4100 is at its retained head `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`.
- **Why this object:** the #4311 coverage map lists "the stopped-moment ... proof outside #4178's caller" as still open.
- **Nearest work, not redone here:**
  - #4178: height recurrence at the Gaussian caller.
  - #4171, #4330: root and ledger numbers.
  - #4424: cover and stock arithmetic.
  - #4375: frame-child reading.
  - #4184: free-word lift.
  - #4371, #4415: the `2^-4p` precision chain.
- **CRT.md is not touched.** I rechecked the board and open PRs just before submission and found no crossing claim.

## Test plan

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost --check-only` | `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS` |
| `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost` | `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`, about 7 s per command, normal and `-O` |
| `python3.12 -O -B research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost/verify.py` | `PASS_COMPLEX_STOPPED_RECURSION_COST` |
| `python3.12 -I -W error -B research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost/verify.py` | `PASS_COMPLEX_STOPPED_RECURSION_COST` |
| `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-stopped-recursion-cost --check-source-history` | `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` |
| `python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_onboarding.py'` | 26 tests OK |

The built-in rejection controls all fail as intended:

- a root above the bracket, `b + 1e-47`, gives `mu > 1`;
- one extra rank-48 child per `W` breaks both moments;
- the ceiling child rule grows width 74 to 96.

Mutation tests: each of these six edits makes the verifier FAIL:

- shifting the stated `1/(1-mu_tau)` window;
- moving the root above the bracket;
- `a_eff > a2`;
- 3000 extra rank-1 children;
- weakening `74^199 >= 72^200` to `>= 73^200`;
- an `e // 72` child rule.

## Open next questions

1. **Node-cost premise.** Do the adapters, the F2 row-addition monomials, the `Gamma`-fold common-cover packet gathers and parking cost `O(V e^(1-a2) polylog p)` at the actual node? First step: a per-node invoice from COMPLEX.md's "Common cover" section, PR2250 §5–6 and #4424's row layout.
2. **Child volume premise.** Do the actual packets realize `Gamma H_r` rank-`r` calls of volume `V/(W Gamma)` each? #4375 shows that the factorwise reading breaks the moment.
